definitions: The action or fact of elevating or being elevated.
A place or a point that is elevated in relation to its surroundings.
The height to which something is elevated or to which it rises.
The angle of a celestial body above the horizon.
A drawing or diagram that shows a building or part of a building as if projected on a vertical plane.
examples: The elevation of the new minister was met with approval.
The town is at a high elevation.
The architect presented the elevation of the proposed extension.
